entities.summary: Ezekiel, Freiherr von Spanheim was a political leaders in Geneva (1629-12-17, Geneva – 1710-11-25), recognized as a landmark figure in the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
